zig.build: zig build-exe -target wasm32-freestanding -fno-entry -OReleaseSmall -rdynamic --cache-dir ../../.zig-cache --dep solution -Mroot=../../zig/shim.zig -Msolution=main.zig -femit-bin=main.wasm && { echo '/*'; cat main.zig; echo '*/'; echo "const WASM = '$(base64 < main.wasm | tr -d '\n')'"; cat ../../zig/run.js; } > submit.js
